payload.core_mechanism_summary: Tree DP computes f[u] (subtree sum) and res[u] (max subtree sum in u's subtree). Second DFS combines two disjoint subtrees by passing the best res from other branches.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP on tree: first DFS computes subtree sums and best subtree in each subtree; second DFS combines two non-overlapping subtrees using max res from disjoint branches, classic tree DP for max sum of two independent subtrees.
